summary: The first Bagley lookout in Oconto County is listed as gone; the Depot Lane tower standing today dates from October 1939.

facts.status_note: Listed as Tower Gone. The standing Bagley tower on Depot Lane has its own entry in the same list, marked standing, and was built in October 1939.

notes_for_editor: Little is known about the first tower. No source read gives its build date, builder, staffing, removal or what remains on site. A search snippet mentioned a 'Bagley (early)' label and a Wisconsin Historical Society site file; neither was verified or used. The distance to the standing tower is a rough estimate from the two sets of coordinates (the first site is about 2.7 km south and 1.3 km west of the standing tower, roughly 3 km), so the story says 'a few kilometres'. The story's 'different structure' sentence was changed to cite the list's own standing-tower entry, since the property record does not say it is different. The 1939 tower facts in the story belong to the standing Bagley tower (a separate record, us-wi-bagley), not to this entry.
